metadata.description: Woz's Claude Code plugins: the wozdev development toolkit and the deep-wiki documentation generator

plugins.name: wozdev
plugins.description: House-style skills with bundled checkers for Markdown (rumdl) and PowerShell (PSScriptAnalyzer plus custom rules), a prompt optimizer that measures before/after token cost, and a sub-agent orchestrator that writes checked, batched execution plans, and a build doc writer that turns rough notes into agent-actionable build documents, and a spec writer that turns notes into a paired PRD and technical spec

plugins.name: deep-wiki
plugins.description: AI-powered wiki generator for code repositories: Mermaid-rich, source-cited documentation, a dark-mode VitePress site, onboarding guides, deep research, AGENTS.md and llms.txt (fork of microsoft/skills deep-wiki)
